integrity.comparison_basis: The suppression laws follow by exact cancellation of the two independently derived degree and Euler formulas.
integrity.degree_basis: Both degree formulas are independently reconstructed from Weyl dimension products for the weight corresponding to the natural two-factor Segre-Pluecker polarization.
integrity.euler_basis: Both Euler characteristics are independently reconstructed as Weyl-group coset counts.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0808.1329 gives first submission 2008-08-09.
integrity.partial_flag_basis: Coskun defines the symplectic isotropic partial flag variety and its natural inclusion in the ordinary partial flag variety.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The bibliographic record for the archival symplectic-flag source lists primary MSC 14G40.

scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the symplectic line-plane partial flag and the natural Segre-Pluecker polarization.
Only projective degree and ordinary topological Euler characteristic are compared.
An equivalent unindexed representation-theoretic observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: A type-C suppression law for line-plane flag degrees
